scopeNotes: Repeated browser prerequisites do not count as additional selected coverage.
Early source-changing and failed runs are excluded. Time-limited attempts without a complete report are excluded.

Later changes to the full-browser selected-case teardown and operator restore staging guard do not alter baseline browser execution. The final legacy DATABASE_URL rejection was separately reproduced and tested, with core/startup and API action audit rerun. Browser fixtures contain no legacy URL. Each report records changedSinceRun explicitly.
All npm test/test:saas cases were run in bounded foreground groups. Full 21/27 browser suites were not run as single complete suites.
No external SMTP/HTTPS, Docker runtime, production data migration, physical iPad/Safari or sustained load verification is claimed.
